steps.name: a confused mind
steps.objective:
Talk to [Media] in 「Kali」, then go to 
「Adrika」 and talk to [Minuet]. Then return to “Kali” and report the quest to [Medea].

lines.text: (The stone touched by Adventurer breaks into several pieces and scatters on the floor. Medea, startled, hurries to catch the staggering Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… are you okay.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I think it's boring... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: %s, endure even if it’s hot. All I have to do is check the contents of the trust.
(Lydia lifts the spirit Roro from her shoulder and places it on %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's not extremely hot, but warm.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Yeah? Askren screamed that he felt like he had been pickled in lava.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'm embarrassed. At that time, I was in the 9th grade, so I just didn't have any tolerance.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: If you want, can I put some roro on it again?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how long do I have to keep this spirit above my head?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: That's enough.
(As Lydia grabs the spirit Roro and places him on her shoulder again, Roro whispers something in Lydia's ear.)

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: The one with the fate of a demon god is waiting in Amaranth Nova, so pierce his heart and destroy him... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: %s, I'll say it again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know. It is said that Iris's voice cannot be heard until the moment the contents of the oracle are fulfilled.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I know there's more you want to say. You can say it, it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I defeat him, I will become ‘Dearside’ who killed God… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: That depends on Barbatos' condition and your will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does this mean you have to rely on luck?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: You don't need to worry too much. We will help you by doing our own thing to avoid the worst.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Us?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, we… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Askren, just a moment. Let me explain.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: In general, trusts prohibit direct intervention by others.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: If ordinary people interfere with oracles, they will be punished with God's wrath. But since Demigods are people who do God's work, it's okay to some extent.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: But we can't do what you have to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Another thing I want to know... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Ah, Shinik and Medea. I'm telling you this just in case you don't know... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I pretty much know what you're going to say. Since the novice goddess who gave the oracle has not given permission, I am telling you not to intervene carelessly.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: There is nothing I can do about it because it is entirely related to Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If it’s the Goddess’ will, there’s nothing we can do… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Well then, I'll just leave. Let's go, Priest Askren. There's a lot to do.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: We've crossed the continent and come all the way here, so we're going already? You can have at least one meal and go.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: … Priest Askren talks a lot, but it's too much. Am I angry? Is Roro here too?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Let's go. I will take care of you.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Everyone, it was nice to meet you. See you later, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Next time you visit, please let us know in advance.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I don't know if it's possible, but I'll give it a try. Well then... .
(Lydia and Askren say hello to everyone and leave the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. I was going to ask where Amaranth Nova was... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My mind suddenly becomes complicated. I'm going to go for a walk in Adrika for a moment.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Let's go together. Medea, I’m going back now too.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, be careful.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. It was fun this time. Next time we have something to do, let's do it together. Also, don't do it alone. Okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then I'll really go. Uh, %s? Where did you go? Let’s go together!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?
(When Minuet encounters Adventurer out for a walk, he steps back as if slightly startled.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah, minuet. Why are you here? Didn't you go on a trip?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Woof… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ah… . hello.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I was originally going to go somewhere else, but somehow I ended up back in Adrica… . For some reason, I feel like I have to come back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you also feel the minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: What are you saying... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Beginner Goddess gave an oracle to %s.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: … Is that so? ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My mind is confused about this... . I want to talk to Iris, but they say I can't communicate since the oracle has been given... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Iris You trust me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course I believe it... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Whatever it is, Iris doesn't want bad results... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: At least it's definitely a choice for this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I thought it was difficult for no reason... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I see you're back with that stupid expression again. Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I want to help, but they say they can't, so this is the only way I can do it. I'll have fun listening to you later, so do your best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's right, minuet. Wouldn't you like to live in Tartarus? It will be more fun than before♡

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you, Shinik. Not now, I'll wander around a bit more and find you... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's a waste. When the minuet came, I tried to make various interesting things.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, it's not fun. Let's go to Tartarus. %s, you go back to Cali. Medea is worried.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it should be.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Well then, goodbye everyone♡ Stay alive until the day we meet again.
(After Shinik says hello, he runs towards Tartarus.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I was going to say hello to Shinik, but I was late… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The minuet is slow. Oh, I'm going back to Cali now.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm going to go back as soon as I can... . I don't know where I'll go, but I'll always be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Minuet.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Goodbye… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Me too now... … … .
(Minuet senses something strange and hurries to get out of the place. At that time, a small black butterfly flies and lands on Minuet's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This butterfly could not be... . Ugh… . Did you call me... .
(When Minuet recognizes the butterfly, her body suddenly loses its strength and falls down.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Mo, I can’t move my body.
(The butterfly sitting on Minuet's shoulder flies away and lands on the tip of the approaching being's hand.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Are you… Barbatos... ?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As the incarnation of Gaia, she recognizes me and this butterfly. A butterfly that was moving along Gaia appeared in front of me with no memory of finding God after its owner fell asleep.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Thank you for writing this, I would like to thank you for this.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's not bad to look scared. It would have been better if this had been Gaia. Let’s leave the small talk here… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Please... Don’t do this… … . This is... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Sounds similar to what I told them... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ka, Kaulini... .
(Barvatos's expression distorts when his name is called. However, he soon regains his calm and relaxed expression and looks at Minuet.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: For now, I will speak as Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I don't feel sorry for you, but I will turn a blind eye and a deaf ear. To prevent the sleeping Gaia from waking up from being trapped in a nightmare forever.

steps.name: a guessing place
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in “Kali” and check the entire situation. Then go to “Guild Alliance City Esnir” and report the quest to [Dana].

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Looking at your expression, it seems like your thoughts have been well organized. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Maybe it was because I talked to Minuet, but I felt better.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is the minuet back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was there no matter when I came. After talking with me, he suddenly left again.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It shouldn't be a big deal.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Are you leaving right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it should be. Once you gather the information... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, this is only for me... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's right, Hilda. This thing... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Did you forget? I'm different from other people. That guy and my soul... … .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: They said no one could intervene but I would be fine. And if you follow it from a little distance... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still not possible.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Even if you don't like it, I'll follow you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I go somehow?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't even think about leaving me alone. Because I think it's something I have to do on my own terms.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you insist... . okay. Let's go together. Better than being alone.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let me ask you one last favor. Cast a spell to relieve the pain. I won’t ask you to do this anymore… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: We'll have to meet again next time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay… .
(Mediah quietly closes her eyes and gently taps Hilda's shoulder with her cane.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can endure it to some extent, but... . If you feel a little tired, come back.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm good at hiding, so if I have to, I'll abandon %s and run away. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do whatever suits you. By the way, Amaranth Nova… Where is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, maybe… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you have any guesses?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is a town called Linford that was closed off 10 years ago. It is one of the pieces of heaven, and is also called the City of Angels.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Are you there by any chance? Climbing up from where the windmill is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. The nearby village of Devesis was associated with Barbatos a long time ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … I thought I could hide in a piece of heaven, but I couldn't get in.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: And Daphne said that the Archduke appeared after recalling memories from the past 10 years ago.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems like something is going on.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Can’t I go in there even now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After hearing the villagers' stories, I went to the front for a moment, and there was something that looked like a large magic barrier spread out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, that's the place I'm suspicious of. So I decided to ask people who might know. Then I have to find a way and go in.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems already too late today, how about leaving tomorrow?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It would be okay to have a day or so. Let’s do as Medea says.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then, as Medea said, let’s take a day off and go tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. Then we will prepare a place for you to rest, so you can spend this evening comfortably.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I would like to greet you in advance. I think I'll be leaving early tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I would like to talk to Jiscard about Mistwood. I was wondering if I might have missed something.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Medea, please be careful.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… . Well, I'll see you two later... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, have a good night… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … Medea needs to get some rest too. There's too much work.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, so who are you going to go to first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You may not know this, but my name is Dana, and I met Barbatos 10 years ago.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You are the second princess of the empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Not much, but a little. I've met him briefly before. They won't know me in detail.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's stop talking now and go and rest. I need to rest if I have to go a long way starting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: When you open your eyes, go to Esnil. I'll chase after you. We can meet soon, so don’t wait like a child.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's go as safely as possible. Surely Ouroboros won't appear now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There will be a chance to tell this story this time.
(Hilda finishes speaking and turns around and disappears behind Medea’s house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda… .
What are you so afraid of? What are you afraid of that stops me?
If it's best for you to disturb me, I'll be your worst moment.
Whether light or dark, just like you did... .
That is the way to end the sin in the name of God... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I had a dream last night...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A person standing in a place I have never seen before... Who is it? I think he was talking to someone...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (……Was it Barbatos? Phew, I don’t know….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There’s no time to stay like this. Let’s hurry. It would be nice if Dana was there….)

steps.name: Blocked Piece of Heaven
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Dana] in 「Guild Alliance City Esnil」, and go to [Uriella] in front of 「Tower of Proof」.
2. After speaking with [Uriella], report the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia」.

lines.text: (As soon as %s's story ends, Dana gently opens her closed eyes.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's funny that a devil blinded by love worked for thousands of years to take Barbatos' power. Besides, now is the time to become a god... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It’s a trust… . %s has to stop Barbatos, but it's a bit frustrating that no one else can intervene... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm also one of those people who wants to kill Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Although I became stronger by eradicating the evil things in the shadows over the years, the moment Barbatos appeared in front of me again, I realized... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He's stronger than 10 years ago, and I can't stop him with my own strength... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So, I don't know what you expected from %s... . The only thing that can defeat him along with the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew, let me put my thoughts aside for a moment. Because the answer to the question comes first. Sorry… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don't know if it's Amaranth Nova, but when Barbatos first appeared, he mentioned a certain place.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He said he had to hold Shiina hostage, go to the heaven he was in, and make everything happen... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: After murdering my father, he disappeared in a hurry, looking like something was wrong... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was there Belial nearby? .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Maybe so. A demon who has been controlling Barbatos for a long time is enough... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But does Shiina have any power? Daphne and Barbatos both said that.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: As a wizard, I have a knack for manipulating magic... . After that, I kept watching Shiina to see if anything bad happened, but nothing major happened.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I won't let anything big happen... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And not long after that happened, I heard there was an earthquake in Linford and the road to the road was blocked... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I went there just in case, but there was a strong magical barrier in place, so there was nothing I could do right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Later, when I gained some strength, I tried various things, but it was the same. If there's anything I learned... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Linford is being influenced by the power of God.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There was only so much we could do as we crossed the shadows. Even if I wanted to know more, I had no one to ask.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But not %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , that's right. There were angels. It's a battle angel that protects God, but in order to talk to it, you have to fight it first.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: They are amazing angels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, there is one person who doesn't fight. Dana, I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: But why do you keep looking back during the story? Who's behind you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I have company. I'm very shy so I'm hiding.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He's an unusual person.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If there is anything I can help you with at any time, please let me know. Just because Aaron disappeared doesn't mean it's over, but I was too complacent... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If anything happens, I'll tell you right away. See you later, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I have something to ask, so I'm glad you came to me first among the sisters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's a bit burdensome to have to start fighting as soon as we meet.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Right? Mika, Rafi, and Gabe start fighting whenever we meet, and I'm also tired. So what are you curious about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain how you came to Urielah.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I guessed it to some extent, but hearing it from your own mouth gave me a different feeling. It’s been a while since I heard that name.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: He suddenly disappeared and I wondered where he had gone, but he was still alive as a demon named Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Okay, let me stop talking about that and tell you what you want to know.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: If the demon world is a space where demons born from the abyss and the tribes that follow such demons reside, the heavenly world is a space where gods and those who follow them reside.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Originally, it did not reveal itself to people, but it seems that some of it appeared in the process of natural integration with this world as the gods disappeared.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Even if the gods disappeared, the places called fragments must have been able to endure for a long time because their power was part of the remaining heavenly world.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: However, it changes when influenced by other forces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I think it was ‘Amaranth Nova’ that appeared with Barbatos. A star of the abyss that appears in a place where the power of God resides... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Star of the Abyss... … ?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: You know ‘Nova’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was a bad wizard who fell by my hands once, and he was called 'the star of the abyss that spits out all the wounds and tears.'

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: It's worth getting scolded for.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Anyway, if the existing power of God and the power of the demon world left by the Abyss Star were mixed together to make Linford like that, then something is strange... .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: If it had turned into such a place, the continent we are stepping on would have already disappeared. It wouldn't have ended with a simple earthquake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: If I can get out of here, I can check... . Angels can move independently of the oracle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. I'll do the rest.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Yeah, I get it. So where are you going now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I’m thinking about it… .

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: What about Elysia? A place of God where you can come and go freely... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . I need to go see it sometime.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Just stay there for a moment. Say hello and leave.
(Uriella approaches and gently kisses her cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So can you tell me why the meaning of 'curse' is different for Hayley?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Okay, let me tell you. Whether you believe this story or not is up to you %s... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: 10 years ago, I came to Linford chasing a demon who was like my enemy. I couldn't find where the demon had gone, so I thought I was in vain and tried to go back... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Linford is in a state where no one can go outside due to a powerful unknown force.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: As I was returning to the village to find out what was going on, the ground began to shake and crack.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: And underneath Linford, black holes appeared with no end in sight.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The huge city of angels floating in the sky was torn apart by a powerful force and fell straight into the holes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's keep listening.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I tried my best to save the people falling into the black hole, but it happened so quickly that there was nothing I could do.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I barely managed to climb up by stepping on the remains of the falling building, but as the situation continued, my physical strength reached its limit.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Then I took a wrong step and almost fell into the black hole... At that moment, a woman with white wings appeared and grabbed my hand.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The moment when a real angel appeared in the city of angels and saved me was like a dream, so I closed my eyes without realizing it... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: When the surroundings became quiet and noisy again, I opened my eyes... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It stood in the center of Linford in its original form, uncollapsed. People stayed there too.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: No one knew there was a black hole in Linford. It was like I was the only one who had that memory, as if it had been replayed.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I tried to rush out, but just like now I couldn't.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: People only know that the city is 'cursed' and they can't go out... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: At this level, you can understand the difference between the meaning of the ‘curse’ that I know and the ‘curse’ that people know… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's hard to believe. So the people in Linford now... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I think it's real. Maybe those people... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: That's why I said it at the beginning. It's your choice whether to believe this or not. Phew… . I feel relieved after talking about it.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I haven't been able to properly tell anyone during this time. Even if I told you, no one believed me... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Even I suspected it was an illusion, but after a while, I was convinced when I spotted an angel flying in the sky toward Whispering Hill and returning again.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I tried to chase the angel and ask him, but he quickly disappeared. After that, it seemed to appear occasionally and find a way out... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: At some point he gave up and didn't show up. I think it's somewhere in Linford... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If it's a situation where even angels can't do anything, then something stronger than the angels' power is at work here.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I guessed it, but is it really the power of God? .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: If there is someone who made this place like this, I want to meet them in person and ask why. Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's still hard to believe, but I'll have to check.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Oh, and after that incident, a place that wasn't there before appeared on one side.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It resembles parts of Linford, but feels different somehow. It wasn't easy to get to.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: When I try to approach it, it moves further and further away, as if it doesn't allow me to approach. I can't reach the end.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Besides… It looks like it stopped when I survived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if you speak calmly, it must have been quite difficult.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I guess it's because they are high elves and have a long lifespan. Probably better than humans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Shall we take a look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I'd like to show you around, but I have some work to do, so I think I'll have to go back to the village first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: And Elliot.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: This story is a secret to the villagers.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ah, yes… . I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: And %s, Hilda, can I go to town first? There's something I want to check... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do it, Elliot.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Go see your family. Let's talk later.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you both… . Then I'll go first.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: … See you two later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the place Hayley was talking about? It looks similar to a village in the distance... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Let's go first.

steps.name: The truth hidden in the city
steps.objective: Talk to [Ariel] in “Aiter Road”, and then go to [Benjamin], [Kiril], and [Charlotte] in “Linford” in that order. And when all the conversations are over, return to [Ariel] in “Aether Road” and report the quest.

lines.text: Who keeps showing me useless things... . I'm nervous, but I guess I'll just have to go.
(In a quiet place on the Aether Road, a woman is standing in front of a restricted area with an annoyed expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess it's here.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Uh, there's someone over there. But what are those wings... ?
(A woman who makes eye contact with the group steps back in surprise. She covers her shoulders with both hands and tries to run away, but is quickly caught by Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why are you running away?
Ugh, there are my wings... Oh no, please let go of my clothes! I was a little surprised when the two of you suddenly appeared... .
This is my first time meeting you. How did you come to Linford? Because of the curse, no one will be able to come and go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because I had work to do. But now I'm talking about the wings on my back.
Ahaha, wings… ? Wings, what do you mean? Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: That thing that looks like it grew on your back. Looking at the black tips of the feathers, it looks like a pigeon or a seagull... .
No, it's our first meeting, but you're speaking harshly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … As expected, it reacts to the wings. A demon with wings?
You are rude to someone who has been blessed by God. My wings are different from those of demons or something! And if it's a demon, it's already dead to Hayley!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are an angel, right?
Oh, no. A being, no, that kind of woman, is just Ariel, trapped by Linford's curse while traveling and unable to return.
I'm a human woman in her late 20s who likes to walk, about 160 centimeters tall... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ordinary people don't necessarily refer to themselves as 'humans'. Also, what is that self-introduction that you seem to have set up?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Ariel have a nickname too? All the battle angels I know call themselves nicknames. If it's Ariel, what is 'Ar'? 'Ar' is like this.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Please, please. Not all angels talk like those idiots. Black... . Please… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ah… It's ruined.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, let me introduce myself. I am %s… . I came here after receiving an oracle. nice to meet you

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … I am Hilda. Are you the angel Hailey was talking about?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's right, but I... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there is a situation. If you help me, I will try my best to handle the situation. It's okay if you refuse, but I wonder how the Holy Spirit will react later if he finds out... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm living here without doing any angel missions, but if you suddenly come out like that... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: There is no other way, right? Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I promised it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … You're more skilled than I thought.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ooh, I messed up… . But I understand that the position of the Holy Spirit is empty... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doesn't Ariel know anything that has happened in the past 10 years? I guess it's because it's here... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ariel briefly that Iris has become a star god.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I see. But what brings you to ‘Amaranth Nova’?
(As Adventurer explains why he came here, Ariel quietly moves his gaze forward.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The thing in front of here is right there. A place where a huge star rose from the abyss and fell, brought by the power of God... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It's a place where powerful divine forces operate, so if you want to go inside, you'll have to listen to the beings there.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: But who is it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, no, Caulini.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I don't really want to talk about that... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: If you want to hear a story from me, go to the village first. Once you go, you'll see what I mean.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Are angels not allowed to speak carelessly about God? It seems like some kind of rule... .
(Ariel continues to say something, but her voice does not come out.)
(Ariel bows her head in resignation.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it... . Hilda, let's go to the village as Ariel said.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There's a lot to hide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: No, let’s go… .
Elliot, you have never forgotten our son’s face in 10 years… . Glad you're back.
(When Elliot can't hold back any longer and starts crying, a man with a similar vibe comforts Elliot's shoulders.)
You've worked hard. I’m sorry that Dad couldn’t come visit you… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: No… . I missed you a lot… .
I have to share this good news with Liana, you know? Your sister hates being interrupted when she’s working.
It's evening before work at the general store is over, so let's wait until then.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… ? Dad, sister... .
I still feel strange. It's been 10 years since you left Linford when you were fourteen, and now you're seventeen... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It's strange to me too. I'm sure it's been 3 years, but you said it's been 10 years... .
I don't understand either. So where did the rest of the time go? .
Still, I have to be satisfied with just seeing you again when you haven't grown up.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Dad, do you remember the day the curse began 10 years ago?
I remember. That day, the ground shook violently, as if an earthquake had occurred.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Anything else?
Well, since I don't remember much else other than that, I guess nothing much happened.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There's Elliot over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the person next to you your brother? They look a lot alike.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ah, %s. sir. Hilda. You have come to town. Hayley took me to another place.
Elliot, these are you… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes, Dad. These are the people who helped me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dad? father?

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: My name is Benjamin. I heard you helped my son, Elliot a lot… . Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello… . I am %s… no see. I thought it was his older brother, but I was surprised when he said it was his father.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: My name is Hilda.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: It's been a while since I've seen an outsider, so I'm a little nervous... I did it. I heard from Elliot that a way has been opened, but I guess I can't get out yet... .

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: When will I be able to go outside? . All Linford residents, including me, had given up, but after meeting you, I felt a sense of anticipation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't tell you in detail... .

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: No. I just want to thank you for letting me see Elliot like this. Linford will be fine somehow.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: I hope you have an uneventful stay while you are here. If you need help, please let me know anytime. We'll help you in any way we can.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Dad… .

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Can I talk to you two for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was thinking of asking Linford for guidance, but it turned out well.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: Elliot, come talk to the two of us and take a look around. It’s been a while… . Dad, I'm not going anywhere, so come back when you have time.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes. I’ll be back… .
(Elliot, seeing Benjamin entering the house, collapses into a cold sweat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Stop without even realizing it... . Maybe it’s because I heard Hayley’s story… I'm sure it's my dad, but I feel strange. and… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me. are you okay.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … My father’s memories are strange. My sister Liana is married and lives in Glaston… . I worked at a general store before I got married... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hmm, maybe my memory is distorted... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I should check to see if there's anything strange about the other villagers... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: If Kirill was doing the same thing as before, he would be in the store.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Because it’s a general store that a lot of people visit, you can hear all kinds of stories… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Please wait a moment. I'll go and see... .

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Elliot, I see it again and it’s still the same. It's the same as 10 years ago. Is it because he looks like Uncle Benjamin and has a baby face?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Welcome, sir. Oh, an outsider? You are the person Elliot was talking about.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes, Kirill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was afraid Elliot would be surprised when we arrived so I said he would go first and say hello.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Haha, it's okay. But I don’t have any information that can help me… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Kirill, please tell me as much as you remember what happened 10 years ago... .

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I don’t even remember what I ate a few days ago, but it was 10 years ago… . Still, I'll try my best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was it like the day the curse fell on the city?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Something like an earthquake happened.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I was afraid that the store I had already invested all my money in would fail because of the earthquake, so I sat down and held on.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: It's a shame, but I did it because I couldn't think of any other way.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I was scared because it felt like I was falling, but the shaking soon stopped.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: So, I thought I would be able to receive goods coming from other regions the next day, but I found out that they were trapped.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: So I thought I was really screwed. Well, I'm holding on somehow so far.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you remember where and what you were supposed to get?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: That was the material for something that was popular at the time... I think it was… . That's strange. I can't quite remember.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: What was it… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: You know those cookies that were popular in Glaston? To make it, I stocked up on ingredients in various cities... Is that by any chance… ?

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Ah, yes. I think so. Did you buy something at a very expensive price? .

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: Haha, it happens like this sometimes. Now that I’m not that young, I often forget.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Everyone says the same thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I saw Elliot 10 years ago, but why does he still look the same? . The ground shook that day, but other than that, nothing happened… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those words seem to be true, but they also have something in common.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Everyone has confusion in their memories... . 3 years ago, no... . I think other people in the village than me have incorrect memories from 10 years ago.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: And it seems like my memory of some parts has been erased... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: The memories Kirill mentioned aren’t even real… . Cookie was just something I said… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I wanted to try it, but it was fake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . But who are you? Why do you keep following me?
I was surprised because it was my first time seeing him.
(A young girl is walking alongside the busy %s group as if they are curious.)
It's Charlotte.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Uh, are you Charles?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Yes… . that's right. But do you know me?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I think I was just born before I left on my trip... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, do you know this kid?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: In Linford, there is a custom where when a baby is born, people go to the house and deliver a personally written letter.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I also said hello to Charles, who had just been born at that time. After all, do other people’s children grow up quickly?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: They say this child is already over ten years old... . … I finally feel it. Time passes strangely to me... .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Uncle Benjamin’s runaway son?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I didn't run away from home, but... .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I came from outside… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah. It came from outside.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: But why don’t you ask me something?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It's a story from 10 years ago, but you were too young at the time to remember... . Sorry… .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I think I can tell you an interesting story.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I've been seeing something strange for some time... . It's hard to explain in words... . Since when has something like that been seen in the city center?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: My mom said she wasn't sure and asked me to ask the grandfather next door. So I asked, and they said it was a spirit that lives in the water.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: They say they tried to drag the dead man to the river... .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: But me and the Linford people are alive... . Strange, right?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Other people don't believe it, but Teacher Haley believes it. So, as I often say, go out on the road every time… .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: It seems like you're secretly holding on to something. Is that the spirit?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: It's okay. All adults do that... . It's all a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you keep my secret, I'll show you a big free ring later. I thought you liked Freeling... . It looks roughly like this.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: There is such a big freeling… ? Do you have wings too? Ah, I miss you… . It would be fun to meet... .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, promise. Hey Elliot, take this kid to me. I'll tell you later when I find out something.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes… . I will.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: promise.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … Aside from that freeling, I'll also tell you a story about an herb spirit that talks interestingly. Charles, I'll take you there. let's go.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Yes, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, we'll see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We go to Ariel.

steps.name: revived spirit
steps.objective: Talk to [Ariel] on the ‘Aiter Road’, and chase after the disappeared [Elone] and talk to her. And when you're done talking with [Elone], return to [Ariel] on the 'Aether Road' and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Haha… . I can't tell you how long... . ah?
(Ariel looks around in surprise and spots %s and the others running in.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, you can talk now.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Have you figured it out now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not accurate, but every resident's memories are slightly off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems distorted, but they don't notice anything strange about it.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: And if an outsider came here for the first time in 10 years, I would be agitated, but I don't really do that. Most people would have to be like Hailey.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief. I was wondering what if you couldn’t feel it… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm not stupid... . It's strange just looking at it.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You feel that way because it’s you… . No one in here thinks anything is strange except me and Hailey... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Falling into the abyss and coming back up is something that only a Kaulini level can do.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The city and life rebuilt by such a god are not perfect. You can make the city look similar to before, but you can't bring back dead life... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: So he brought the river of death to this place and took a long time to scoop up the floating souls... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Right now, life in Linford and Linford is barely holding on. Living for eternity, trapped in a piece of heaven, with distorted memories... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I don't know what Kaulini expects this place to be, but it's probably going to stay like this.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The good news is that he didn't recognize me and Hailey... . And it means that Charlotte's soul was truly saved... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I guess I couldn't let the soul of the youngest child in the city pass away. He barely survived, but after that, Charles saw something that looked like a spirit... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Anyway, I had no choice but to remain silent. Then people here can live without knowing the truth.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm glad you came. Now that I have someone to tell this story to... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So are you relieved?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: A little… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if it is said that angels are beings that transcend life, those people are not alive even if they are alive... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know it's not Ariel's fault, but I don't think it's for the best.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: As a helpless being, I couldn't help it. He's already an incompetent angel... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I appreciate your understanding, but I'm not incompetent. I just don't have the motivation... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Could it be that the God you served... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It probably perished at the hands of the Beast or Kaulini during the time called Twilight.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's enough of my boring story. Just think about what you will do next.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: And just pass by like you didn’t see me. Because I am an incompetent angel. Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Incompetent angel Ariel, can you enter Amaranth Nova now?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: His energy in Linford recognizes you, but I don't know if you can get inside. Try walking forward.
(At that time, sharp plant branches begin to flock behind Ariel's back, one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, come this way. It's dangerous!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes? Ugh!
(In an instant, the branches wrap around Ariel's arms, legs, and neck, tightening them little by little.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ugh, ugh… . Why me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, wait a minute!! Hilda, come and help. Who on earth… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Be careful, there's someone over there.
(Someone slowly appears between the large broken branches.)
(A woman is holding a lamp with soft light in one hand and a sharp, cold sword in the other.)
Angel, continue to be silent as you have been until now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that Rauma? No, it’s Guilty… ? no. It's neither... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Eh, Elone… … … . If only you hadn't gone to Belial then... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elone… ?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: It's all an old story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Because He called. It was reduced to ashes in the mirror of Belial and thrown to the ground, but He awakened it again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Elone, don't do this here.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I don't want to hear it... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You wanted to save everyone, Belial used you to corrupt Kaulini... … .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Anyway, back then I was… I am… . Uh, I remember… ?
(With those words, the lamp Elone was holding breaks, and the flame inside falls to the floor and begins to burn the surroundings.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh no. If we leave this the fire will spread to Linford!

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I said that... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Perhaps….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elone, aren’t you distressed? You blamed yourself. I was used by Belial, but I didn't want to do that, it was a trap... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: … I-I… . only… .
(Elone stutters, turns her back and runs somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, follow that spirit called Elone or something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I understand.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: This fire can never be put out except by Elone! It's dangerous if we leave it like this!

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Whoa, calm down and look at me. Ariel.
(Hilda grabs Ariel and quietly sits her on the floor, then takes out a dagger and cuts her thumb, causing a drop of blood to drip out.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I didn't want to see any more blood, but I couldn't help it... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: No way, you… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Sorry, be quiet.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Did I do that... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I don't remember... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: A being regenerated in a state that is lacking in a space decorated like its original appearance... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Kaulini, is it possible that your condition is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you muttering to yourself like that?
(Elone turns around and stares at the approaching Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don’t we have something to say to each other?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Let me talk first. I will lead you to Him, but I cannot meet you right away just because I want to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't think it would be easy to meet.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Come meet me in the river of hatred and oaths. Then you will be able to understand it naturally.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If you don't... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if you don't?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: You'll lose everything you love, including Linford.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Taking them hostage and even threatening them... . Does Kaulini want to be that kind of god?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I don't think I can answer that question.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If you have made up your mind, ask the angel for directions to the river. I'll be waiting at the end of the river.
(As soon as Elone finishes speaking, a black butterfly flies from somewhere and turns into a curtain of darkness, swallowing him up.)
(Soon it rises into the sky and disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … After all, it won't be easy to go without a fight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go back to where Ariel is… .
(At the place where everyone disappeared, something comes up from under the bridge on the highway, flapping its black wings.)
(Then he slowly looks around and smiles.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I like it. For a stage created by imperfect beings, I think it’s okay… . Then and now... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Although not everything is as satisfying as you are.
(When Belial touches the mirror, the image of Barbatos, who is going somewhere, is reflected.)
(At that moment, Barbatos' gaze in the mirror meets Belial's. The man sneers and then aims his pistol.)
Clink.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Hehe, he’s not an easy man after all… .
(Belial comes out of the mirror, grabs the bullet that hits his face, and drops it on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'll come see you soon falling apart. wait. It's my own cowlini that doesn't belong to anyone... .

steps.name: river of death
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ariel] on the ‘Aether Road’ and enter the ‘River of Hatred and Oath’. 
2. Defeat [Elone] in the “River of Hatred and Oath.” Then, go outside through the reward room and report the quest to [Ariel] on the “Aether Road.”

lines.text: (When the blood flowing from Hilda's fingertips touches the tip of the sharp plant stem, the stem stops moving and disappears through the floor at high speed.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Phew, this is the end... . Ariel, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I survived.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hey Hilda… . Are you going to get involved with the trust?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … Should I say I intervened? ?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's not what I meant... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Well. You'll have to see.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I thought it was an incompetent angel, but surprisingly... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's because he's an angel. And it's not that you're incompetent, it's just that the job doesn't suit you. Oh, hey… %s is coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you two okay?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Are you okay? What happened to Elone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He entered the river of hatred and oaths and disappeared, telling us to find him.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: You have to go eventually. You can't go against the trust. If you do that, it could become even more dangerous... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hilda, you can't go to the river.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It is currently called the ‘River of Hatred and Oaths’, but in reality it is the ‘River of Death’.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: At the end of its lifespan, a soul without a body is sent back to the world after a time of rest by leaving its body in the river.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: In the process, I lose my previous memories... . This is a law that even God cannot break... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even God….)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It seems like someone has cast a spell to protect the souls of the two people, but it's dangerous if they go together.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: There is a high probability that one of the two can be recognized as a soul from the dead. Then, without realizing it, they will jump into the river and try to go through the process of purification.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: This is a space where the rules of reality do not apply at all... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Isn’t it time yet? ? %s, sorry. Go alone this time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: (Amaranth Nova will be no problem...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. That's nothing to be sorry about.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: But how is Elone there?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The River of Death is still flowing, doing its job, but in some areas it is subject to Kaulini's will.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: 10 years ago, I brought out and saved many souls, and recently I also brought Elone back to life. That's why Elone can go to the river.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I have one more question. Why is it called the ‘River of Hatred and Oaths’?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Long ago, Kaulini 'hated' the gods who corrupted him and 'swore' that he would judge them... . Right on the spot... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm sure there's more, but that's all I know.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ariel knows that well.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's because he's an angel... . Ah, Hilda keeps stopping me. I just worked quietly… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Ariel. Then, can I just take the road I see in front of me? .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Just a moment, %s.
(Ariel quietly holds %s's hand and lightly kisses the back of it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … ? What, what?!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: … I must have mustered up the courage to greet you as an angel... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . It's like a cheek kiss from battle angels. Thank you, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Now, you two, I've told you everything I know, so please just pass by as if you didn't see me. I'll go home and do nothing and be quiet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, I'll be back. Let's talk later. sorry.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'll hold Ariel here.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: People with similar souls are the same, even down to the most obnoxious things. ha. yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, the river of hatred and oaths... . And the river of death... .
(The sky and earth colored in purple, and the endless river. The moonlight flowing over it as if melting catches the attention of Adventurer as he enters the road.)
(Every time you take a step, the scent flowing from the flower garden beneath your feet stimulates your nose.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my... .
Splash.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought there would be a place like this... .
Splash… with a splash… .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: You probably don't want to face the extinction of your soul here without being able to reach him... .
(Adventurer, startled by the approaching lamp light, looks around and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If you fall that way, you lose your memory. Please wait a moment.
(When Elone lifts the lamp to illuminate the surroundings, the water under %s's feet disappears as if scattering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When did I go into the water...?)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Slowly, climb up through the path seen between the flowers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elone.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't you help me?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Well, I don't know. I'm just following my master's will. I don't think I can really help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I came up well.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: That's it... .
(Elone checks the condition of %s above the water and turns his back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, where are you going?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: To be where I'm supposed to be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I need to make sure I'm ready first... . Now they will come in droves.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: When the master was dragged into this river by the hands of those he trusted and drowned... , the worst emotions a god could have also flowed into this river.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: The spirits here must have faced those emotions and become confused.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: The disappointment and anger that the owner felt toward other gods was passed on to some spirits, and for others, it became the reason they had no choice but to go to the demon world... .
(Elone raises a blue burning lamp towards the moon hanging at the end of the river.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: The spirits here are waiting for you.
(With Elone’s words, the spirits that had been hidden by the light of the lamp slowly appear.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Do you feel that feeling... I'm just trying to see if I can handle it all... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I just hope you can overcome them... . If you don't do that, you'll be swept away by this river and disappear somewhere... .
(The flame of the lamp Elone is holding goes out. At that moment, the moonlight that filled the space and the presence of Elone disappear.)
(The moment the moonlight spreads out, as if the moon is waking up again, the eyes of the spirits standing in the flower field and river all turn to one place.)
(The moonlight shows white butterflies quickly flapping their wings behind %s, who runs to avoid the spirits trying to come up the road from the river.)
(Just like one day, butterflies cover Adventurer like a huge curtain. Through it, a blue light from a lamp that appears to be Elone's flickers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elone.
(As the flame in Elone's lamp burns the white curtain, the flowing purple river appears again as if the moonlight melts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you make the spirits retreat?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: They are there. It's just that we are in a different place. Anyway, I see your determination.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Now it's time to see the spirit Elone's determination to follow her master's will.
(The flame in the lamp in Elone’s hand burns brighter and brighter.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: … I will never repeat the mistake of being destroyed by the devil's hand.
(Then the ice sword in his other hand also emits a powerful chill.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, it's different from Rauma and Giltine in the mirror. It's stronger than before...)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Let's get started now. I will be different from the worst version of myself in the mirror.
(The blade of the ice sword falls to the floor with a loud sound, and the blue flame flowing from the lamp no longer burns but evaporates.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I'm sorry for doubting your ability to fight Belial... . Your determination is greater than mine, so this is what happens in the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now open the way to ‘Amaranth Nova’.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I will guide you as promised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I trust you?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If you don't communicate with me, you won't be able to meet him or save Linford... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: After I send only one person to Him, you... .
(At that time, a large mirror appears in front of Elone and %s from somewhere, and a woman slowly comes out of it.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: For some reason, I couldn't go see Kaulini.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Belial here... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Wait, will you stay still?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? what? Suddenly my body… .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Elone, please send me to where he is instead of that man. They said I could only send one.
(Belial smiles softly at Adventurer, who cannot move, then looks at Elone and caresses the mirror.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Elone, come on. I don't say it twice.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Like the devil you are, you have already told lies dozens and hundreds of times.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Don't mess with my feelings. Even if you were brought back to life by his hands, you are just an insignificant spirit to me... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You know what happens if you disobey me. Pain worse than %s's current state will visit you.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I will be the first to go see him, not you. %s, enjoy the rest of your time like this. Because there are many spirits who will play with you in this river without Elone.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Belial, please take my hand. I will lead you there.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'm glad you understand what I mean.
(The moment Belial holds Elone's hand, a thick black plant stem rises from the floor and binds Belial and Elone's hands together.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: You're using such foolish tactics. Do you really think you can tie me up with something like this?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Uh, huh? Ugh, ugh. Can't you let go of this?
(Soon, a thick plant stem comes up from another direction and entangles Belial's legs and arms, making him unable to move.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: I'd like this seat... .
(With those words, the place where Elone and Belial are standing suddenly turns into the edge of a cliff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Elone. What are you going to do... ?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: That's funny, Elone. I can't believe you're struggling like this here. Why don't you quit right now? How are you going to take care of it? Ugh, town? Eup-eup.
(As Elone approaches Belial and covers his mouth with his hand, a thick stem wraps around them.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Belial, you have told me too many lies... . On the other hand, I've only done one thing. Is that too much?

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Belial, I will erase your memories of twilight and go to a world where you will never wake up again.

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Then that person can go see him.
(Elone holds Belial and looks at the river flowing under the cliff.)

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: Kaulini... .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: You put my ‘complete annihilation’ as a condition for opening the door to Amaranth Nova… .

lines.speaker: 엘로네
lines.text: If this is your will, and if you forgive me for the sins I committed back then... .
(At that moment, the river water, bathed in purple moonlight, splashes and small water droplets jump towards Elone.)
Plop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow!
(The moment a white butterfly flies and lands on %s's head, the all-white vision returns to its original state.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Apparently, while following Elone, he met Belial, and Elone… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… … .
(There remains a trace of a thick plant branch being cut off where Elone was standing just a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For Elone, any choice to go to Amaranth Nova would ultimately lead to death... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(The small white butterfly sitting on %s's head slowly flies forward and returns again and again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's moving as if it's telling you to go that way...)
(When I take a step towards where the butterfly is flying, this time it flies straight forward without turning back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I can see the scenery of Linford in the distance... I think I can go outside...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can we go to Amaranth Nova now? What is Barbatos doing there….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ha, I have no choice but to go out and check first...)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: How dare I… . Cluck, cluck… .
(Belial slowly crawls out of the river with a tired expression on his face.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: This is what the feeling of extinction felt like... . Ha, I never thought I would feel this way... . All this time, we were just deceiving the dying people... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Something thrilling. Ha, Kaulini... . What on earth are you hiding in Amaranth Nova?
(Belial stands up, wiping the blood from his lips. When he draws a circle with his fingertip, a large mirror appears in its place.)
(Belial, who was slowly entering the mirror, stops and looks at the moon reflected in the mirror.)

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: Kaulini, you're probably watching me from here too, right?

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: The only fun moment is now. Let’s have some fun. Now I'm going to deceive you of everything.

steps.name: what the devil wants
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ariel] on the ‘Aiter Road’ and check everything that happened at the place where you chased [Elone]. 
2. When everything is over, go to the streets inside “Linford” and check the town’s status, then return to [Ariel] on “Aiter Road” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Uh, uh huh? Oh, earthquake?
(As Linford shakes severely in front of her, a startled Ariel hurries to grab Hilda's hand.)
(It tries hard to fly with its small wings, but falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: … We have to run away quickly… . Otherwise, like back then... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Calm down, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I couldn't save people... . Because I couldn't save him... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's not Ariel's fault.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Even so… . uh? When did the shaking stop?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I think it stopped for a few seconds or so. There doesn't seem to be any sign of it shaking again.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's a relief. But something is strange... .
(Ariel flaps her wings again and rises into the air.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What is it? Why did you fall earlier?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: My wings were gradually deteriorating, so it was impossible to bring another person up there. But hey… Amaranth Nova... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it's flying.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That's because he's an angel. Uh, when did you come?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What is this... . are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. But what's going on with Amaranth Nova?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: … I think I can access it now. Before, when I approached, I was pushed back due to the strong magic power, but now it seems that the magic power has weakened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, that’s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ariel and Hilda what happened at the River of Hatred and Oath.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: If Elone had fallen into the River of Death with Belial, she would have already perished. But there is one part that is hard to believe… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: That Kaulini used the spirit he cherished in that way... . Something is strange.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you have any guesses, please tell me.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I don’t know the details, but it seems like something is different from the old Caulini… . sorry. That's all I can say.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Ariel, I have a question... How do you know Caulini so well?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Rather than saying I know it well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will later ask Iris to take into account the fact that I ran away without doing the angel's work.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yeah, really?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, it's ruined... . I can't help it. I'll just tell you.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The God I served in the past said he would go to judge the devil of deception, but he never came back... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: The remaining spirits and angels were entrusted to various gods, but I was entrusted to Kaulini. I got to know Elone while running errands... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: At that time, I learned that the demon of deception was Belial. It is said that many gods, spirits, and lives have been corrupted... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Then one day, while I was running a quick errand, Beast appeared... … .
Clink.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: What is it? What is this sound?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the sound of Belial's mirror breaking... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Has Belial appeared again? Let's go to the place where the sound is heard.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'll be keeping an eye on Amaranth Nova in the meantime... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Then I will ask you a favor. Let's go, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah.
(The sound of a mirror breaking continues to be heard, and the two wander along the Aether Road, following the sound, but stop at a certain point.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: There's no one. I think I definitely heard the sound of a mirror breaking nearby... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After meeting Elone here, I entered the river of hatred and oaths.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, stop.
(At that moment, thick darkness comes from somewhere and fills the space where the two people are standing.)
(In the darkness, a figure appears from somewhere and begins to flow, rippling like a river.)
I witnessed it. I saw a colleague who was with me disappear in an instant!! He died in an instant!!
It tried to erase this world, including us here. Why don't you believe it?
What?
On this planet, there can't be a being stronger than us, called 'God' for life?
Then, how can we explain the demon world born from the abyss? . You don't acknowledge that there could be a world we don't know about.
Arrogant people... . Come to your senses… . If we join forces, we can defeat that monster.
We can protect our world... . If you create a star with the power drawn from the abyss and drop it on the monster... .
Why are you attacking me? I am not your enemy.
Why are you trying to cover my mouth!! Why are you trying to kill me by turning me into a human?
You already knew... .
To kill me... . A village in the clouds that has nothing to do with anything... .
Is this your answer? Is this really what you wanted? .
Bug-like people who don't even make the slightest effort... .
You probably thought that if you made me like this, that would be the end... . You probably didn't know that he would come back as Deerside... .
Tell me how much more I have to cut before I can get back. I don't know... . Hehe, I don't feel sorry for you, but please die.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: This would be a good name for you as you fall into the demon world with despair.

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: The Prince of Despair, Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 벨리알
lines.text: I'll be looking forward to the day you wake up again. In the meantime, you can just spend your time quietly in the demon world... .
(The moment the illusion of Belial approaches, the loud sound of a mirror breaking is heard from somewhere.)
Clink.
(The moment you hear the sound of the mirror breaking, your eyes widen as if you were greatly shocked.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: … It's the same this time too. As if someone was showing this on purpose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this what Belial is showing? .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I don't think it's Belial... . Is it Daphne? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess not. There's no one here but us... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't underestimate Daphne. Even after going through him, I still hear that sound. %s, but what's attached here? Something like spores... .
(The moment Hilda removes the thing attached to %s's back, the sound of something breaking is heard.)
Clink.
Clink.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Where do you hear it? Even though I wandered down the street, I couldn't see anything like a mirror... .
(At that time, several mirrors that appear to be Belial's appear above Linford's image in the distance and shatter one after another.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, look over there!! Mirrors are breaking in public!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, let's go. People are dangerous!! Let’s go to town quickly!!
(As the two people return to Linford, demons and beasts that seem to have been seen before come flying in and crash into the building.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: %s, be careful!!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Uncle Caluso, say that before you throw a punch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lydia? When did you come?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Just arrived. Somehow I was able to come directly to Linford without going through the Aether Road.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I don't have time to talk long, so I'll keep it short.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: While Uncle Caluso and I are buying time by dealing with the demons, here is Priest Askren... Priest? Where did you go?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Please save me, senior!! The demons are chasing me!!

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: A friend who secretly takes a lot of effort. I never thought his fighting ability was as good as a freeling... . Lydia, I'll go.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Okay, Uncle Caluso. sorry. Because of Priest Askren... . Anyway, the priest will deploy a barrier to protect Linford.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Even if it looks like a fool, one thing is certain. You already experienced it when Icarus' wings fell, right?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: That large airship was able to go into the space behind it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: He is a talent who can effectively use the secret arts of the ancient elves. So there are many places calling here and there. He said he could soon become level 4, but is it true… .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: … Anyway, we don't know what will happen in Amaranth Nova, but the aftermath could put Linford in danger... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: But who would have thought that the devil Belial would appear here, throw the mirror and disappear... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: %s, Hilda. The two enter Amaranth Nova. We'll deal with the demons here and prepare for any emergency.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Do you already know about me?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: What about that... don't mind. Anyway, take care. Quickly go to Amaranth Nova.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Then please take good care of Linford.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Lydia, send it here!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Loro, go and strengthen Uncle Caluso's fist.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Phew, thanks to you I survived. Now I just need to check two more places.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Well done, Priest Askren. The demons are scared, so take advantage of that opportunity and run!

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, senior!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Uncle Caluso, first of all, evacuate all the villagers. Fortunately, I don't think anyone was hurt.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Lydia, the people here... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: I know what you're trying to say. But for now, Priest Askren must focus and provide support so that the oracle can be fully completed.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: There is a place where sacredness and evil intersect in a piece of heaven... . What the hell is this place… .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It’s painful, painful… . These memories... … .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Priest Askren, come to your senses!! Don’t feel the emotions of the memories coming into your head!!

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Roro, bring out the anger within me... . I need to finish it right away... .

steps.name: time of despair
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Ariel] in “Aether Road” and enter “Amaranth Nova.” 
2. Defeat [Demon Kaulini] in “Amaranth Nova.” Then, go outside through the reward room and report the quest to [Ariel] on the “Aether Road.”

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Go away. Ta, don't follow me.
