(Ariel runs away from the demon beast and ends up falling.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Even if an angel like me tries to eat it, it won't taste good... .
Boom!
(At that time, the demon is hit by a strong shock and flies away.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Are you okay, Ariel?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank you, Hailey... . Then I'll just... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Where are you going, angel?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, how did you know?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: At that time, those beautiful wings looked like this... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: It seems like something blocking that place has disappeared... . Right?
(The moment Hayley tries to approach Amaranth Nova, Ariel grabs her and pulls her.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: No way. If a normal human or elf approaches it, it may disappear.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Even though I am a high elf who has lived hundreds of years longer than other elves?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Still doesn't work... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hailey. Were you here? Ariel, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I'm fine. Hailey helped here.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Thank goodness. But Hayley, what are you doing? Did you find out everything?
(Haley is fiddling with the small wings on Ariel's shoulder with a curious look.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Ah, sorry. It looked so soft that I placed my hand on it without realizing it.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It's okay. Now I can't hide it anymore... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I think I was influenced by the divine power within it after I was able to go to Amaranth Nova.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Oh, is the village okay now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demigods and priests from the church come out and fight against demons and demons. It seems like the villagers have already evacuated... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: … It is fortunate that the demigods and priests of the church came... . Please tell me the name of the devil who owns that mirror.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It's Belial.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayley, please work with Ariel here to clear out the demon beasts. We have work to do there.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Us? Uh, okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Ariel, thank you for your help. I'm just saying that I would let Iris know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: … no. are you okay. excuse me… Once you enter Amaranth Nova, you won't be able to come out until things are resolved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It won't be an easy road, but be careful and come back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, Hilda.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Yeah... .
(As Adventurer and Hilda run towards Amaranth Nova, demons and beasts come at high speed from inside the road as if they were waiting.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Ariel, can you use recovery magic or something?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It's not magic, but something similar is possible.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Okay. then… Walk when I ask… . Because I will now get rid of everything in front of me.
(A hole in the city created when a star awakened from the abyss fell. Adventurer and Hilda run while looking around to make sure they don't fall into it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's even more miserable than what I saw from afar... . Besides, what is this suffocating energy?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It is the energy of the heavenly world that cannot be properly felt in the heavenly sculpture. Now I finally feel like I'm in God's realm.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: %s, I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: This is... That's the energy he has. %s, step back. hurry!
(At that time, a black butterfly flies out of nowhere and unfolds in front of the two people, creating a silhouette of one person.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... ,

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I've been waiting for you, %s. I wonder if today might be the last time I get called by that name.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hilda is here too. %s I was expecting you to come alone... It's a shame.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Haha, I guess it doesn't matter. All right. Anyway, now that you have met me, it will be difficult for the two of you to get out alive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks different than before.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Is it a compliment? Well, that's it. I was hoping that the goddess and Adventurer would be here together, but it's a shame.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I like those eyes full of contempt. Well then, let me end here.
(The moment Barbatos raises his sword towards the two people on guard, blood flows from his mouth and eyes.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … no way… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … It can't be like this... .
(I wipe away the flowing blood, but tears clearly flow and open the wound further.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is wrong….)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Why did I gather my strength to become a god again... . Cluck, cluck… .
(Barvatos wraps himself in a cloak and quickly turns around and starts running.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, stop!!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… . %s… . Should we postpone the time we have been looking forward to for a while? It wouldn't be fun if it looked like this... .
(With those words, Barbatos throws himself into the black hole in the center of Amaranth Nova.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What, what?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I think something happened to Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's chase it. But how do I get down from here to there? Should I just throw myself... ?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Stop, %s. You can't jump right here. It will disappear immediately. Look carefully.
(When Hilda throws a stone toward the black hole, it turns into powder and scatters without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Don't forget that we are now in God's realm. You have to move carefully... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Hilda… . But what is down there?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You'll find out when you go... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ha, ha... . Hey... .
(As you climb down the black hole emitting pulsating magical energy, you see a ruined temple. After wandering around for a while, you spot someone giving off black energy from afar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's Barbatos, Hilda. Hilda? are you okay?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Uh, it's okay... .
(Barvatos senses the presence and slowly walks over, wiping away the red blood from his mouth and eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Have you finally arrived?
(The ‘Grand Duke of Despair’, a demon who is far from a holy god and has become darker and blacker, makes eye contact with the two people and a sneer appears on his lips.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I was waiting. I happen to meet you here. Even though it's not the situation I wanted... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … There is no problem with harvesting two people's souls. So before we start, I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … It's a trivial old story.
(When Barbatos closes his eyes, a powerful barrier of magic rises around him, and a stone statue representing a person hidden behind a pillar appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Soo, I'm out of breath... what is that again...?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Long, long ago, there was only one way to defeat the monster that was trying to devour gods and all life.
(With his words, an ancient landscape unfolds as if flowing beyond the magical barrier.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … That monster would have been defeated when the Holy Spirit was a human, but that was all at the time.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: At that time, the gods did not fight, with only some sharing certain 'secrets'... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The secret is that this star will be destroyed by the Absolute. Maybe it's an old man you know.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The people who created this world and said they loved life actually did not protect life and were preparing to run away to another world... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The process was partly hidden behind the name ‘Twilight’.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Lethe was exiled, Hecate was trapped in eternity... . You know the rest... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I just feel sorry for the gods who died without knowing anything... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: They tried to kill me by turning me into a human too, but they overlooked one fact. That I too was born as a god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, the pain that came when Belial touched my memory reminded me of the star that fell into the abyss with me, and I headed here.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Because their graves were down here in Linford... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I think I regretted not being able to protect my precious life and vowed not to lose it again... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Why doesn’t that feeling come to mind now? .
(Barbatos closes his eyes, and powerful magic swirls around him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jeez, it’s on a different level from the power I’ve felt so far. Well, what is it… It’s like this…)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Similar to the time of Demiurge... no, more than that... huh?)
(Barbatos opens his eyes again, gathers his magic power, focuses it on the gunblade, and fires it in one direction.)
Clink.


(The sound of a mirror breaking and someone's screams are heard mixed together.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How dare the devil try to interrupt this moment... .
(Barvatos makes eye contact with Hilda with a satisfied expression.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hilda, you are ready to hurt yourself. But why don't you step aside now?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This moment is me and %s… . If you bleed here and now, Ouroboros will come and ruin everything.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It wouldn't be of any help to the current goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda, step aside. I'll do it now. don't worry.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Don't worry... .
(Hilda bows her head and steps back, and Barbatos' face distorts.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It makes me uncomfortable to see you like that. Do you care what happens to yourself?!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even if I become Deerside for the sake of others? Even if you lose yourself for the goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even then, I am the same. I've already made up my mind, so don't ask me again.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: At one time, I felt the same way about the world as you did. But I fell into the abyss with a feeling of despair... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now let me show you the end. The Adventurer of the goddess… .
(With Barbatos' words, a gold coin appears from somewhere and lands in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The power of those who tried to kill me became mine...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will kill the weak goddess you love and imprison her in this coffin like other gods... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will become the owner of all the souls in the world and the things they love and rule this world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even if it is a demon god that does not match holiness... .
(The gold coin bounces out of Barbatos' hand and stops in the air.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If there is something you want to protect, if you want to move forward, don't be afraid and kill me.
(The moment %s's face is reflected in the gold coin, the trigger of the stopped gunblade is pulled.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: “Mortal, from now on, this time is your ‘despair.’”

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: You couldn't stand it... .
(Kaulini's bullets, transformed into demons, fly one after another to %s, who is groaning in pain.)

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: I couldn’t handle it… .
(Red liquid falls where Kaulini's great sword passes and pools on the floor.)
(Caulini points his gun at Adventurer, who is struggling to hold on while covered in blood.)

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: I admit that my time with you was as great as I expected. It just didn't reach me.
Boom.
(Caulini smiles after seeing the unfocused eyes of Adventurer lying on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: I'll put it in there especially for the gods who loved you. To dream of the abyss with them.
(Kaulini lifts Adventurer with one hand and tries to move it to the coffin containing the remains of the gods. At that moment, he makes eye contact with Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Kaulini.

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: You're calling God's name in vain. But I will especially forgive you this time. Hilda, now you can go back to your own time and enjoy this moment.

lines.speaker: 마신 카울리니
lines.text: Now that Adventurer is dead, your soul can live whole as well. If you want, I'll send you back in time.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: It sucks to go back to a world that will soon be destroyed... .
(Hilda smiles and takes out a dagger and stabs the tip of her index finger. Blood flows to the floor and quickly seeps towards Kaulini and %s.)
(Kaulini is shocked and tries to stop the blood flowing, but the blood mixed with Amaranth Nova's magic continues towards them without stopping.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Kaulini, it's great that you threw me into the original world line so that I wouldn't get involved in the first place. It's really amazing.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I am a witch with cursed powers. You use the power of recovery and regeneration in the opposite direction at the cost of hurting me... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I'm glad the demon doesn't care about me... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: The place I am now is a world that will soon disappear... . If it's going to disappear anyway, it might be better than being swallowed by Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: My soul, I give it to you.
(A dazzling light that the eyes cannot even contain fills the space and causes a huge explosion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Wow! Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened... ? Surely I am to Barbatos... … .
(Adventurer, looking around, spots Barbatos smiling faintly and quickly strengthens the hand holding the weapon.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Like when I was dragged into the river... I hoped it wouldn't be the worst... .
(Barvatos bites his lip, takes out a gold coin from his pocket, and flicks it on the gunblade.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!!
(The loud sound of weapons clashing against each other fills the space. And someone's weapon, which had been shaken even an inch, bounces.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is the time.)
(And %s's blow passes by, aiming for that gap.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s, you came back alive and brought me this humiliation... .
(Barvatos collapses, vomiting and smiling crookedly at %s who is looking down at him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos. No, Kaulini. He was once a god who loved life, but now he is just a demon who wants to pollute the world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must have been unfair. But this is not the place to vent that anger... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … Cluck, cluck… . Is that so?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: So where should I pour these emotions into?! Cluck, cluck.
(Barvatos caresses the gunblade fragment stuck in his chest.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Then please teach me. So that I can look at the world again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, you have already spent too much time as a demon in the demon world.
(At that moment, Adventurer catches the sharp gold coin flying above his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A coin with devil horns engraved on both the front and back... . Then the conclusion is decided.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Heh… , you got caught.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's over now. Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … With this… … … It’s the end… … … … .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I don't think... … … .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I won't... … .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, are you awake?
(Iris is holding Adventurer's hands and looking at them with worried eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… ? Iris Is that right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How is Iris here? But here… .
(Iris carefully hugs the confused Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is inside Amaranth Nova, where the decisive battle took place a while ago. And all the oracles I made have come to an end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's over... . Phew… .
(Adventurer, now relaxed, sighs lightly, perhaps feeling relieved.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. By carrying a big burden... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now this space we're in won't let me move out of the great wall.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, the time created by Caulini will also be corrected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Linford too?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The wall blocking Linford is gone. Residents can also come and go freely.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The souls of the residents who were sacrificed by Kaulini and then reawakened returned as before.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Still, since you've been hurt once, if something similar happens, you could break down at any moment.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The memories of the residents have not disappeared, and they will continue to live as before, preserving the past times.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll be there to make sure they don't fall apart, so don't worry too much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… . Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you have that item?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What object?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is what Medea gave me in the Kali village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this. They said it would help stop Daphne... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you remember Hilda?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who? Hilda?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda… ,

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: He helped me make this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? I'll have to say thank you when I see you later.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Shall we go now?
(Iris creates a bow of light 'Celestia' at the tip of his finger with a lonely look in his eyes. A beam of light from the sky circles the tip of the bow and becomes a beautiful arrow of light.)
(The sharply condensed arrow of light moves forward and creates a huge door of light.)

steps.name: half-cleared clouds
steps.objective: Talk to [Ariel] in “Aiter Road,” pass the angel statue in “Linford,” and find [Elliot]. And when all conversations are over, return to [Elliot] in “Linford” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: … uh?
(Ariel lowers her struggling hands and looks around for fear of getting her wings bitten by the demon beast.)
(Haley, who made eye contact at that time, hits the demon beast at her feet with her baton and then looks in the direction of Amaranth Nova.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: The demons and beasts that attacked this place are disappearing... . Wake up, Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank you. uh?
(At that time, a circle of light is created in the distance, and two people walk out of it.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Looks like he's coming back after finishing well.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: I think the feeling coming from Amaranth Nova is the same... . Hey, who are you and %s… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, Hailey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello, Hailey and Ariel.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: We're okay. Is everything done inside? But this person… .
(Haley makes eye contact with Iris and takes a step back in surprise and lowers her head.)

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: … nice to see you.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Excuse me, but who are you? If you came out of there with %s, I don't think you're an ordinary person... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Angel, please pay attention.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ariel, this is Iris… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Iris… sir? ah!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Alas, I was wrong, my God. sorry. The reason I ran away then was... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay, Ariel. It's just a thing of the past.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Then, do you forgive me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please do well in the future.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Ah, that will work. from now on… … ?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Is the Linford case over now? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, can I tell these two people?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Hayley and Ariel how the situation ended.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Thank goodness… .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Haha… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now you two don't have to feel guilty anymore. I will never allow a star to fall that hurts and spits out tears again.
(Smiles of relief appear on Hayley and Ariel's faces.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please take good care of Linford in the future as you have so far. As always, Hayley punishes the demons that threaten the world... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ariel is the guardian angel who protects Linford, and please make sure nothing dangerous happens in front of Amaranth Nova.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why are you so surprised? You've been resting a lot during this time.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: But... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please carry on as usual and make sure their spirits do not fall apart.
(Iris smiles brightly and strokes Ariel's wings.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, one day, you will be able to regain your original wings.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Wings just like before... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Yes, I will work hard!

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: By the way, %s, didn't you come with someone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came with Elliot, a Linford resident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Iris, is it okay to keep emptying the oracle room?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's not that I'm away... . How should I explain this... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Now it is possible to separate and govern the Godhead and the personality to some extent.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: While inspecting the great wall as 'God' in the Chamber of the Oracle, you can move as 'Iris'.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Although it can't last for long... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Wow, this is amazing! Until now, there has been no one like Iris... .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: There are cases where people created incarnations like Gaia or transformed into human beings like Agni.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Awesome job, Iris!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: … I never thought I would get compliments for something like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does this mean that I can now move freely... If so, my responsibility will also increase...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. I'm not used to this situation right now, so I think I should go back and rest.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We need to find Daphne quickly between the great walls... . I'll call you soon.
(When Iris puts his hands together, a circle of light is created in front of him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hello to you both.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: See you later then.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Goodbye, Iris.
(Iris receives everyone's greetings and steps into the circle where the oracle's room can be seen.)
(As the figure of Iris disappears along with the circle of light, Ariel, relaxed, collapses on the spot.)

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Whoa… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay, Ariel?

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: It’s okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go to the village now. What are you two going to do?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: I never thought I would meet a real-life star god in person... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Oh, I have some business to do and I think I need to talk to Ariel.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hayley, me?

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: You have to do it, Ariel. Iris’s name… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Hmm, I was forgiven for the past, but… I never thought I would continue working in the future... . (muttering)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, see you later then.

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: Yes, %s… .

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: %s, you walk fast. As soon as you finish speaking, you disappear. But behind Hailey... .

lines.speaker: 헤일리
lines.text: What else is there? Argh!! It's a big freeling.

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: I'm surprised. ring.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Juri ring?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: Ariel, nice to meet you. long time no see. ring. Juri Ring is here. ring.

lines.speaker: 아리엘
lines.text: Has it been 10 years? No, has it been 100 years? But what happened?

lines.speaker: 쥬리링
lines.text: It's support. ring.
(Someone carefully tugs on the collar of %s as he enters a residential area and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Charles, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: It's okay. At some point, the bad things disappeared… .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: And now I don't seem to see anything strange anymore... .

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: I won't ask what happened. I just think it happened thanks to the priests who fought hard over there.

lines.speaker: 샤를로테
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Charles... .
(As if he saw Charlotte saying hello to %s and returning home, Elliot comes running crying from afar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: My father, my father... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why Mr. Benjamin?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: My memories come back perfectly, I feel like they came back!! Kirill is also fine!! Everyone else too!!

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ugh… !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Elliot, stop crying.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Hehe, yes… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: So, is %s's work in Linford finished?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. So I'm looking at the village now.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: It still feels like three years ago since I left Linford, but I try not to care anymore... . Whether it’s been 3 years or 10 years, I’m glad to be back home… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Next time I get a chance, I want to go to Dorothy Village and say thank you to Glinda, Vina, and Uncle Runo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I stop by Dorothy's village on the way, I'll give you my regards.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you, %s. and… … .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Oh, again… I think there was someone… . Who is it? The Yorijori Spirit and the Munchkin clan are not... .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: You're not planning on leaving anytime soon, are you?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: My father wants to repay the priests who worked hard for the village. therefore… Please be sure to stop by my house… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: … It’s okay if you don’t come, but I think I’ll be a little disappointed… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. Don't cry.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you. %s… .

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'm going to go to Kirill's store to buy some things. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Elliot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've been to all of Linford... There doesn't seem to be anything dangerous anymore... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, let’s go to Benjamin’s house… .

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: Once again, I greet you on behalf of the village people. Thank you very much for protecting our village.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: No, I just did what I had to do.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Thank you for treating us so grandly. I just thank the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Mr. Benjamin, it’s so delicious that you won’t even know if the two of you die while eating it. Well, I wish you all the best while you are in Linford.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Priest Askren, we will leave early in the morning.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes? You came to Linford, the city of angels. There's so much to see, but you're already going?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: There's 'more' work to do.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: … I'll stay here. You two go.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: This is what an Askren priest must do. The goddess will be happy too.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: If the goddess says so, then I have to step forward.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: An elf that is easy to handle. I thought all elves were serious like Hayley... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha… .

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: This is really old Linford. Now I can come and go as freely as I did back then... I have so many expectations.

lines.speaker: 벤자민
lines.text: I have a lot to talk about with my son, so I will step aside first. Thank you all for your time.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you all.

lines.speaker: 키릴
lines.text: I have to clean up the store, so I’m going back now. Hello everyone.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Everyone has gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to go in now and take a rest. Everyone, take a break. Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: … I don't think I realize it yet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's nothing. Rather, I want you to go with me. Daphne has somewhere to go.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Now, if you are Iris, you probably have some idea of where someone is, but if it is a place where even Iris can't be found... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: No way… .
(Askren drops the bread he was holding and looks at Lydia.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Are we really going to the demon world?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: No, it's an elf village.
